How to read this. Cards run in the order the model produced them, so scrolling down is scrolling forward through training. The number top-left is the sequence index, top-right is the geometric score. The six thin bars are collision · contrast · density · imbalance · overflow · textfit — red bars mark the specific defect. These are sampled rollouts (roughly 1 in 6, capped per worker), not every rollout the model generated — enough to see the trend without storing tens of thousands of decks.
